items.title: Why LLMs Fail at Causal Discovery and How Interventional Agents Escape
items.title_zh: LLM 为何在因果发现中失败，以及干预式智能体如何突围
items.summary: The authors prove a kernel obstruction theorem showing that supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization and in-context learning produce predictors that cannot distinguish causal graphs generating similar observational data. They propose Agentic Causal Bayesian Optimization, where a frozen LLM acts as an interventional oracle inside an external Bayesian loop; it matches fine-tuned baselines on Corr2Cause without training and outperforms fine-tuning and preference optimization on the new 24-variable Extended Corr2Cause benchmark.

items.title: PEAM: Parametric Embodied Agent Memory through Contrastive Internalization of Experience in Minecraft
items.title_zh: PEAM：在 Minecraft 中通过对经验的对比内化构建参数化具身智能体记忆
items.summary: PEAM moves Minecraft agent memory from inference-time retrieval into model parameters, pairing a slow deliberative LLM with a Mixture-of-Experts LoRA module of isolated adapters that internalizes failure-correction pairs. The design is reported to consolidate skills without catastrophic forgetting.

items.title: FALAT: Tracing Failures in LLM Agent Trajectories via Dependency-Guided Search
items.title_zh: FALAT：通过依赖引导搜索追踪 LLM 智能体轨迹中的失败
items.summary: FALAT frames failure attribution in LLM agent trajectories as dependency-guided search: it constructs an expectation of how a task should be solved, traces dependencies among decisions, tool outputs and agent messages, and tests whether correcting a candidate step would recover the expected outcome. On the Who&When benchmark it reaches 46.0% step-level accuracy on algorithm-generated trajectories and 29.1% on hand-crafted ones, outperforming specialized baselines and direct prompting.

items.title: Is Agent Memory a Database? Rethinking Data Foundations for Long-Term AI Agent Memory
items.title_zh: 智能体记忆是数据库吗？重新思考长期智能体记忆的数据基础
items.summary: The authors argue that long-term agent memory is a new data-management workload whose correctness is a property of the state trajectory rather than individual records, and identify four failure modes: unregulated growth, missing semantic revision, capacity-driven forgetting and read-only retrieval. They formalize Governed Evolving Memory with ingestion, revision, forgetting and retrieval operators, argue that no record-level system can satisfy six correctness conditions, and prototype MemState on a property-graph backend.

items.title: Reliable Post-Retrieval Assembly for Agent Memory: Separating Evidence Extraction from Policy Execution
items.title_zh: 面向智能体记忆的可靠检索后组装：将证据抽取与策略执行分离
items.summary: The paper studies post-retrieval assembly failures, where a memory system retrieves relevant evidence but answer generation entangles semantic filtering, conflict resolution, prior suppression and output generation. On MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation at 262K tokens, separating evidence extraction from policy execution reaches 82%/93% single-hop and 27%/41% multi-hop with gpt-4o-mini/gpt-4o, versus a best reported 54% single-hop in the benchmark comparison and at most 7% multi-hop across the 22 reported systems.

items.title: From Model Scaling to System Scaling: Scaling the Harness in Agentic AI
items.title_zh: 从模型扩展走向系统扩展：扩展智能体 AI 的执行框架
items.summary: The paper argues that the next bottleneck in agentic AI is system scaling: designing auditable, persistent, modular and verifiable harnesses around foundation models. It analyzes context governance, trustworthy memory and dynamic skill routing, proposes harness-level benchmarks for trajectory quality, memory hygiene and verification cost, and releases CheetahClaws, a Python reference harness compared with Claude Code and OpenClaw.

items.title: RICE-PO: Turning Retrieval Interactions into Credit Signals for Reasoning Agents
items.title_zh: RICE-PO：将检索交互转化为推理智能体的信用信号
items.summary: RICE-PO is a critic-free policy optimization framework that selects high-uncertainty executable retrieval actions as anchors, evaluates local counterfactual branches with retrieval metrics, and propagates credit to latent reasoning steps only when reasoning-to-action influence is strong. On BRIGHT and BEIR it consistently outperforms prompt-based agents and group-based RL baselines under the same retriever.

items.title: CiteCheck: Retrieval-Grounded Detection of LLM Citation Hallucinations in Scientific Text
items.title_zh: CiteCheck：科学文本中 LLM 引用幻觉的检索接地检测
items.summary: CiteCheck retrieves candidate publications from external scholarly sources, compares each citation against them with a structured LLM verifier, and maps scores into Exact, Minor and Major labels. On a 982-citation physics benchmark with controlled corruptions, it reaches 88.7 macro-F1 and 88.9% accuracy, outperforming GPT, Claude and Gemini baselines including web-search and few-shot variants.

items.title: Simorgh at SemEval-2026 task 7: Region-Aware Hybrid Retrieval for Low-Resource Cultural Reasoning in Multilingual Question Answering
items.title_zh: Simorgh 参加 SemEval-2026 任务 7：面向多语言问答中低资源文化推理的区域感知混合检索
items.summary: The team proposes region-aware hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 lexical matching with dense semantic similarity and regional weighting heuristics, feeding a structured prompt to a quantized Qwen3-14B with logit-based deterministic answer selection. On the 30-language BLEnD culturally grounded QA benchmark, hybrid retrieval improves cross-lingual stability over pure parametric inference, but gaps remain between languages with more and less training data.

items.title: Beyond Recall: Behavioral Specification as an Interpretive Layer for AI Personalization
items.title_zh: 超越召回：将行为规范作为 AI 个性化的解释层
items.summary: The paper introduces representational accuracy to measure how faithfully an AI system captures a person's interpretation and operationalizes it as a Behavioral Specification that compresses personal data into interpretive patterns. Across 14 autobiographical corpora it recovers most of what a raw corpus provides at roughly 25x less context cost, and it is tested alongside Mem0, Letta, Supermemory and Zep.

items.title: MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research
items.title_zh: MobileGym：面向移动 GUI Agent 研究的可验证高并行仿真平台
items.summary: MobileGym is a browser-hosted mobile simulation environment that judges outcomes deterministically over structured JSON state and can run hundreds of parallel instances per server. It includes a 416-template benchmark, and GRPO training on Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct gained 12.8 points on the test set.

items.title: Agent Explorative Policy Optimization for Multimodal Agentic Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向多模态智能体推理的智能体探索式策略优化
items.summary: NVIDIA's AXPO targets the Thinking-Acting Gap in multimodal agents by fixing thinking prefixes and resampling failed tool calls. On Qwen3-VL-Thinking it is reported to beat GRPO by about 1.8 points, and an 8B model surpasses the 32B base on Pass@4.

items.title: Bridging Reasoning Trajectories in On-Policy Distillation via Near-Future Guidance
items.title_zh: 通过近未来引导弥合同策略蒸馏中的推理轨迹
items.summary: The paper shows that on-policy distillation's token-level learning signal cannot reliably bridge student trajectories toward teacher trajectories, since about 30% of high-loss tokens are surface-form mismatches rather than real reasoning forks. Its Trajectory-aware OPD uses near-future trajectory information to identify divergent states and distribute guidance, improving average accuracy to 52.2% from 47.8% for standard OPD.

items.title: Skill0.5: Joint Skill Internalization and Utilization for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: Skill0.5：智能体强化学习中的技能内化与调用联合优化
items.summary: An East China Normal University framework internalizes general skills through privileged distillation while keeping task-specific skills external, routed by a difficulty-aware router that penalizes shortcuts on easy tasks. It is reported to outperform memory- and skill-based RL baselines on ALFWorld and WebShop.

items.title: Dynamic Coordination Strategy Selection for Enterprise Multi-Agent Systems
items.title_zh: 企业多智能体系统的动态协调策略选择
items.summary: The paper evaluates whether coordination strategy in enterprise multi-agent systems should be selected dynamically by problem class rather than fixed globally, running 30 tasks across six industries, five problem classes and four model arms with 1,440 judged outputs. The pre-registered exact-winner criterion was not supported, but a weaker near-best routing claim held in every arm and problem class, with the predicted strategy within 0.10 quality-score points of the best observed condition.

items.title: Task diversity produces systematic transfer but inhibits continual reinforcement learning
items.title_zh: 任务多样性带来系统性迁移，却抑制持续强化学习
items.summary: The authors introduce Banyan, a GPU-accelerated continual RL domain in which map layouts, objects and sub-goal dependency structures can be varied independently. They find increasing diversity along each axis induces systematic transfer, but too much diversity inhibits continued adaptation: learners plateau on new tasks while still improving on old ones.

items.title: Household Movement Detection in Mixed-Format Occupancy Data Using LLM-Based Entity Resolution
items.title_zh: 基于 LLM 实体解析的混合格式居住数据家庭迁移检测
items.summary: The paper combines prompt-based LLM named entity recognition, semantic text embeddings and graph-based reasoning to detect indirect household-movement links in unstandardized name-address records. On SPX benchmark datasets S8-S12 it improves recall by 8-15% while maintaining high precision, with F1 gains of 6-8% over a strong pairwise baseline.

items.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：自我进化智能体技能的执行策略
items.summary: Microsoft Research's SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains agent skills as external state of a frozen agent, accepting bounded edits only when a held-out validation score strictly improves. It is best or tied on all 52 tested model-benchmark-harness cells and drew 228 upvotes.

items.title: PEAM: Parametric Embodied Agent Memory through Contrastive Internalization of Experience in Minecraft
items.title_zh: PEAM：Minecraft 中通过经验对比内化的参数化具身智能体记忆
items.summary: PEAM converts agent memory from inference-time retrieval into parameter-resident skills, pairing a slow deliberative LLM with a fast multimodal Mixture-of-Experts LoRA module that has per-category isolated adapters for continual learning without catastrophic forgetting. Failure-correction trajectory pairs are internalized through behavioral cloning plus a contrastive objective, and a parameterization-worthiness score plus self-triggered consolidation decide what and when to internalize; Minecraft experiments show improved long-horizon performance and parametric-versus-retrieval efficiency.

items.title: Better Later Than Sooner: Neuro-Symbolic Knowledge Graph Construction via Ontology-grounded Post-extraction Correction
items.title_zh: Better Later Than Sooner：基于本体约束后置修正的神经符号知识图谱构建
items.summary: The paper proposes a neuro-symbolic pipeline for ontology-grounded knowledge graph construction that combines open-domain extraction, embedding-based canonicalization of types and predicates, and targeted LLM correction of ontology violations deferred to a post-extraction stage. It reports substantially lower token usage, improved KG consistency and preserved downstream QA quality, and measures SPARQL graph patterns to show the graphs suit symbolic querying.

items.title: Mind Your Tone: Does Tone Alter LLM Performance?
items.title_zh: 注意语气：语气会改变 LLM 的表现吗？
items.summary: The study tests whether prompt tone changes LLM accuracy on objective multiple-choice questions using a 50-question set with five tone variants and a 570-question MMLU subset spanning 57 subjects with seven tone variants. Across ChatGPT-4o, ChatGPT-5-nano, Gemini 2.5 Flash and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, tonal effects are systematic but highly model-dependent, and the authors caution against assuming tone-robust reliability.

items.title: AI Research Agents Narrow Scientific Exploration
items.title_zh: AI 研究智能体正在收窄科学探索的范围
items.summary: Analyzing 37,802 ideas from four AI research-agent frameworks and six LLMs, the authors find that AI-generated ideas are more concentrated and closer to seed literature than human work. The differences arise mainly from recombining existing methods.

items.title: On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training
items.title_zh: 论智能体工具调用的有效性与效率及强化学习训练
items.summary: The paper analyzes tool-calling evaluation pipelines and finds reported performance can be highly sensitive to implementation choices such as random seed, system prompt, multi-turn template construction and how prior interaction history is carried forward. For training, it identifies wasted computation in rollouts without learning signal and in policy updates, then introduces two techniques reported to accelerate RL-based tool-calling training without degrading performance.

items.title: AgentDoG 1.5: A Lightweight and Scalable Alignment Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
items.title_zh: AgentDoG 1.5：面向 AI 智能体安全与防护的轻量可扩展对齐框架
items.summary: AgentDoG 1.5 is a Shanghai AI Lab alignment framework for AI agents, trained on roughly 1,000 taxonomy-guided samples to produce guardrail models from 0.8B to 8B parameters. The authors report performance comparable to closed-source models such as GPT-5.4 and release all models and datasets.

items.title: KG-Guard: Graph-Based Hallucination Detection for Knowledge Base Question Answering
items.title_zh: KG-Guard：面向知识库问答的基于图的幻觉检测
items.summary: KG-Guard formulates hallucination detection in knowledge base question answering as answer-node classification and treats the answering LLM as a black box, representing each instance as an augmented graph with a virtual question node. It reports F1 of 82.0, 87.4 and 84.3 on WebQSP, ComplexWebQuestions and PUGG with roughly 305x fewer parameters than LLM-based baselines, and feeding flagged answers back improves downstream KBQA F1 by 13.0-14.5 points.

items.title: Benchmarking Security Risk Detection and Verification in Open Agentic Skill Ecosystems
items.title_zh: 开放智能体技能生态中安全风险检测与验证的基准评测
items.summary: SkillVetBench is a two-stage security vetting benchmark for open agentic skill ecosystems: semantic vetting over each skill's natural-language specification, then sandboxed execution of flagged skills to collect auditable runtime evidence. Built from confirmed malicious skills in the live OpenClaw ecosystem, it finds semantic-only and signature-based baselines miss up to 89% of malicious skills, with runtime attacks concentrated in high-permission primitives such as exec, write_file, install_skill and spawn.

items.title: Bridging Requirements and Architecture: Multi-Agent Orchestration with External Knowledge and Hierarchical Memory
items.title_zh: 连接需求与架构：融合外部知识与分层记忆的多智能体编排
items.summary: MAAD is a knowledge-driven framework that orchestrates Analyst, Modeler, Designer and Evaluator agents to transform requirements specifications into multi-view architectural blueprints with quality attribute assessments. It injects architectural standards and patterns via RAG, uses a hierarchical memory of design history for iterative refinement, and is reported to produce more complete, modular and traceable architectures than MetaGPT across 10 case studies.

items.title: Med-HEAL: Analyzing and Mitigating Hallucinations in Medical LLMs with Hallucination-Aware In-Context Learning
items.title_zh: Med-HEAL：利用幻觉感知上下文学习分析与缓解医疗 LLM 幻觉
items.summary: Med-HEAL builds a hallucination dataset by evaluating BioMistral-7B on open-ended clinical question answering from EHRNoteQA, with outputs labeled by a GPT-4o LLM-as-a-judge pipeline plus human auditing by medical student reviewers. Across five open-source LLMs, a self-critique pipeline improved accuracy for three of five models without parameter updates.

items.title: JuneYaooo/nihaisha-nishi-tcm
items.title_zh: JuneYaooo/nihaisha-nishi-tcm：倪海厦中医课程学习的 Agent 技能
items.summary: An Agent Skill for studying Ni Haixia's traditional Chinese medicine courses, covering course retrieval, formula-pattern and acupoint lookup, study-note organization and screenshot evidence indexing. The Python repository had 2,198 stars and 477 forks.

items.title: backnotprop/pstack
items.title_zh: backnotprop/pstack：面向严谨 AI 辅助工程的技能与原则
items.summary: pstack packages skills and principles for rigorous AI-assisted engineering, built for use with Claude, Codex and pi. The JavaScript repository had 2,805 stars and 212 forks and is tagged agent-skills and claude-code.

items.title: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG
items.title_zh: StarTrail-org/PixelRAG：像素原生搜索，终结网页解析
items.summary: StarTrail-org's PixelRAG is an open-source Python project pitched as the end of web parsing and the beginning of scalable pixel-native search, tied to an arXiv paper and pixelrag.ai. It had 10,352 stars, 918 forks and topics including RAG, memory and multimodal.

items.title: zhnt/loushang
items.title_zh: zhnt/loushang：Python 编写的 AI 原生编程智能体框架
items.summary: loushang is a Python agent harness for coding workflows with multi-model LLM orchestration, stateful sessions, tool governance and provider routing for GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and MiniMax. The repository had 1,870 stars and 294 forks.

items.title: AhmadHassan-BTed/Noria
items.title_zh: AhmadHassan-BTed/Noria：面向即时通讯平台的智能体抽取器
items.summary: Noria is a JavaScript agentic extractor that receives messages and URLs through chat, scrapes web data to score content against custom matrices such as jobs or scholarships, and returns a structured summary with a match score. It had 3,076 GitHub stars.

items.title: PentesterFlow/agent
items.title_zh: PentesterFlow/agent：终端里的智能体化攻击性安全工具
items.summary: PentesterFlow/agent is a TypeScript tool that brings agentic offensive security into the terminal, aimed at penetration testing, bug-bounty hunting and automated security auditing. It had 1,419 GitHub stars and 258 forks.

items.title: RUC-NLPIR/Arbor
items.title_zh: RUC-NLPIR/Arbor：通用自主研究智能体
items.summary: Arbor is a Python generalist autonomous research agent from RUC-NLPIR that runs experiments, conducts research and iteratively optimizes its work without human intervention. It had 1,127 GitHub stars and 128 forks.

items.title: Claude Opus 4.8
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.8 发布
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, which it says brings stronger performance across coding, agentic tasks and professional work, plus the consistency to handle long-running work. The Hacker News thread drew 1,774 points and 1,376 comments.

items.title: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex
items.title_zh: 用 Codex 构建可自我改进的税务智能体
items.summary: OpenAI describes how OpenAI, Thrive and Crete built a self-improving tax agent with Codex that automates filings, improves accuracy and accelerates workflows.

items.title: A shared playbook for trustworthy third party evaluations
items.title_zh: 可信第三方评估的共同行动手册
items.summary: OpenAI shares guidance on third-party AI evaluations, covering how to assess model capabilities, safeguards and validity for frontier systems.

items.title: Claude Code – Everything you can configure that the docs don't tell you
items.title_zh: Claude Code：文档里没写的所有可配置项
items.summary: A developer's reading of the Claude Code source code documents undocumented configuration, including hook fields that rewrite commands mid-flight, persistent agent memory, plain-English auto-mode rules and self-improving loops, with copy-paste examples. The post drew 326 points on Hacker News.

items.title: Notes from the Mistral AI Now Summit
items.title_zh: Mistral AI Now 峰会笔记
items.summary: Conference notes from a few days in Paris at the Mistral AI Now Summit cover open models, on-premise deployment and agentic harnesses, along with Mistral's ambition to be Europe's full-stack AI partner. The post drew 466 points and 214 comments on Hacker News.
